---
title: "Setup"
---

This page describes how to install software when working with Boolean network modeling.

The installation process will work best on Linux.

On Windows use the [Windows subsytem for Linux][wsl] and follow the Linux instructions.

On MacOS the command line tools by Apple are required. Install them with:

```bash
xcode-select --install 
```

[wsl]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/wsl/install

## Learn pixi

Currently, the best way to do scientific computing is via [pixi] software which is considered to be 
the next generation of `conda` environment management. With pixi you can create isolated software environments with a wide range of software packages. 

All instructions here assume that you have `pixi` installed.

[pixi]: https://pixi.prefix.dev/latest/installation/

```bash
# Quick install pixi. See the pixi website for the latest instructions
curl -fsSL https://pixi.sh/install.sh | sh
```

Open a new terminal to apply the changes.

## Initialize a project

Pixi allows the creation of local enviroment. Make a new directory then initialize it:

```bash
# Initialize a new project directory
pixi init

# Add Python 3.12 and some useful packages
pixi add python=3.12 pip click graphviz pandas numpy matplotlib
```

This creates the `pixi.toml` file which contains the project configuration. environment. 

## Activate 

Load a shell with the environment activated (analogous to `conda activate myenv`).

```bash
# Activate the enviroment
pixi shell
```

## Install software

Once inside the shell, you can install software from within the shell environment as well. 

## Forked repositories

We maintain copies (forks) to existing software packages that have small fixes applied to allow them to operate on modern Python versions and to fix various problems arising from running them on different operating systems. All fixes are contributed back to the original repositories.

```bash
# Install booleannet
pixi run pip install --upgrade booleannet

# Install pyboolnet
pixi run pip install git+https://github.com/BooleanNet/pyboolnet

# Install pystablemotifs
pixi run pip install git+https://github.com/BooleanNet/pystablemotifs
```
